components.description: Two-digit seven-segment beacon readout in a dark bezel, each digit with its own decimal point - the numeric display UfiSpace prints under the model name at the top left of the S9611-36D faceplate, drawn with every segment lit as the vendor's own artwork draws it
components.name: seg7-beacon-s9611

components.description: Two-digit seven-segment status display in a dark bezel - the numeric readout UfiSpace prints at the right of the S9600-72XC faceplate. Each digit is addressable through the sixteen characters a seven-segment cell can form, and the drawing's own face is unlit
components.name: seg7-status-2

components.description: Two-digit seven-segment status display in a dark bezel, the small 12.8 x 6.8 mm size UfiSpace prints under the model name on the S9610-36D faceplate - both digits drawn showing all segments and both decimal points, as the vendor's own artwork draws them
components.name: seg7-status-2-sm
